Maya (People Ops): Quick q — manager asked to backdate an IC->L4 promotion to 2026-04-01 even though evidence was submitted 2026-04-20. Is that allowed?
Jordan (Eng Manager): Yep, team want the effective date to match ramp milestones. Is there a strict evidence window?
Priya (Comp & Benefits): Policy: promotions are generally effective on or after the evidence date. We can approve retro up to 30 days before evidence with Sr. People Ops signoff + manager justification. Anything beyond needs exceptions.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Ok — manager attached 3 bullets of impact + peer feedback. Would that satisfy "justification"?
Maya (People Ops): Sounds reasonable. I'll route to Sr. People Ops. What about equity/proration and payroll?
Carlos (Payroll): If we backdate effective date, we need two things in Workday: a retro comp change and an equity grant correction. For payroll we need the retro form by the cutoff. Cutoffs: payroll cutoff is `YYYY-MM-DD` at 5pm PT two business days before pay run.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Rough timeline if we approve today?
Priya (Comp & Benefits): If approved today and docs in by the cutoff, retro pay processes in the next pay cycle. Equity correction depends on the grant system — usually 1–2 weeks to regenerate grant + legal signoff.
Carlos (Payroll): Action items: 1) Manager to attach docs in the People Ops case, 2) submit Workday retro comp change with `retro_reason=PromotionBackdate` and `effective_date=2026-04-01`, 3) include payroll journal code `PR-RETRO-2026` in the ticket. Example fields:```employee_id: 12345
effective_date: 2026-04-01
comp_type: base_salary
new_salary: 142000
retro_reason: PromotionBackdate```
Maya (People Ops): I'll create the Sr. People Ops approval thread and add the docs. @Priya is signoff the only requirement on comp side?
Priya (Comp & Benefits): Yes, Sr. People Ops + Comp review. Also need manager attest to no conflicts with headcount or leveling guardrails.
people-ops-bot: Case #PO-2026-874 created: Maya added manager justification doc.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Submitted Workday form and linked case number — thanks.
Carlos (Payroll): Received. Note: if case completes after payroll cutoff, retro will go next cycle. Estimate retro payment on 2026-06-15 pay date if all approved this week.
Maya (People Ops): Great — I'll ping Sr. People Ops and close the loop once approved. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Jordan (Eng Manager): Appreciate it, will let the IC know tentative timeline.
Priya (Comp & Benefits): Quick reminder — any equity recalcs may affect strike price/tax paperwork; comp counsel will reach out if needed.
Maya (People Ops): Noted. Closing next steps: Maya will escalate for signoff, manager to file Workday retro with `PR-RETRO-2026`, payroll to process once signed.
Carlos (Payroll): Copy.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Thanks all.
